summary: Tested Training Workbook feature end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_training_workbook.py with 15 pytest cases covering all 4 priorities (happy path notes/practice/quiz, Astral quiz, certificate rollup, auth guards). Found and FIXED one real bug: route ordering — GET /certificate/{module_id} was shadowed by the earlier catch-all /{module_id}/{lesson_id} route and always returned 404 'Unknown lesson'. After fix, all 15 tests pass. Frontend E2E via mobile viewport confirmed: Psychic Training lesson modal renders Certificate progress ring (0/5 lessons quizzed), My Notes textarea with 'Autosaved on blur' footer, Practice Log with +/trash controls, and Quiz auto-loaded with 5 questions × 4 radio options. Astral Training level cards show gold-bordered 'Open Workbook' pill; tapping opens a fullscreen modal with identical workbook sections and 0/4 certificate ring. correct_index is NOT leaked in /quiz responses (verified). Wrong answer count returns 400 as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID attributes anywhere in workbook components — makes future automated E2E fragile (had to use text-based selectors)

'Load Quiz' button never appears in Psychic Training modal because the quiz auto-loads on lesson open (fine functionally, but the review request explicitly mentions a 'Load Quiz' button). Verify this matches PRD.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av ^16.0.8 is listed as a dependency (deprecated). Not imported anywhere in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/components, so safe to remove and migrate any future usage to expo-audio / expo-video. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json:26

Numerous deprecated RN-web warnings on load: `shadow*` (use boxShadow), `textShadow*` (use textShadow), `props.pointerEvents` (use style.pointerEvents), and 'useNativeDriver is not supported' fallbacks. Not blocking but noisy on web preview.
Console warning: '[Layout children]: No route named "files" exists in nested children' — a stray reference to a non-existent route.

action_items: Optional: add testID props to LessonWorkbook (notes-input, practice-input, practice-add-btn, quiz-submit, cert-ring) for future E2E stability.
Optional: remove unused expo-av dependency from package.json (deprecated; not imported).
Optional: replace shadow*/textShadow* style props with the modern boxShadow/textShadow equivalents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
Investigate '[Layout children]: No route named "files" exists' warning in the Expo Router layout — either add the file or remove the reference.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/backend/routes/training_workbook.py — the GET /certificate/{module_id} route was declared AFTER GET /{module_id}/{lesson_id}, so FastAPI matched 'certificate' as module_id and returned 404. Moved the certificate route above the catch-all handler. This bug would have made the frontend cert ring on the Astral 'Open Workbook' modal show 404 whenever a fresh lesson state was requested via the standalone certificate endpoint.
LessonWorkbook.tsx is 788 lines — consider splitting Notes / Practice / Quiz / Certificate into 3-4 subcomponents (>700 LOC guideline).
Quiz caching is keyed by (module_id, lesson_id) globally — good, but there's no admin-facing regeneration endpoint if a lesson's content is edited later.

rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/training-workbook/certificate/{module_id} returned 404 'Unknown lesson'. Root cause: FastAPI matches routes in declaration order. The catch-all GET /{module_id}/{lesson_id} was declared before GET /certificate/{module_id}, so any request to /certificate/beginner-1 was matched as module_id='certificate', lesson_id='beginner-1'. _find_lesson('certificate', 'beginner-1') returned None → HTTPException 404. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' <BASE>/api/training-workbook/certificate/beginner-1` → 404. Fix: moved @router.get('/certificate/{module_id}') declaration above the catch-all route. Verified: returns 200 with correct certificate JSON.
